purpose: Frozen CLIP-only encoding of actual rendered app UI candidates. No labels, choices, thresholds, or trained preference model were read or used.
runtime: scripts/image-evaluation-runtime.mjs; local_files_only; cached model files linked read-only from work/image-pretraining/cache/models; no model download or training.
scoring: js/services/imageLearning.js imageClipPrompts + semanticScores; js/services/imagePreferences.js cosine. selected is app semantic score; rawTargetCosine is direct cosine against target meaning text embedding.

gateReference.provenance: frozen app gate in js/services/imageSemanticGate.js; reported only, not applied to labels or threshold selection

input: a/blind-review/index.json file/hash inventory joined by candidate ID to a/blind-index.json exact rendered UI URLs and exact word/POS/definition.
sceneAvailability: The six original galleries have no saved scene prompts. The open and closed galleries have the saved custom concepts "open door" and "closed door", respectively; no generated scenes or contrasts were available. Custom concepts are passed as scene prompts only for those two galleries.
